data.name: Psychic Curse
data.description: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to curse a living creature within 30 feet with your psychic magic. You can choose one of the following effects: memory lapse, mental block, or pain confusion. If you choose memory lapse, the target loses its memory of the past %1 hours. If you choose mental block, you can proscribe one specific action, such as attacking with a type of weapon, casting a specific spell, or something else suitably specific (subject to the GM's discretion). The target can't take that action without first succeeding at a Will save (DC %2). If it fails, it can take other actions instead. If it attempts the prohibited action again on subsequent rounds, it gains a cumulative +2 bonus on the save until it succeeds. If you select pain confusion, the creature is confused for 1d4 rounds whenever it is damaged by a critical hit. The target can attempt a Will save (DC %2) to negate this effect. This effect lasts for %1 days. A creature can't be under the effects of more than one psychic curse at a time. This is a mind-affecting curse effect.|InvestigatorLVL|10+InvestigatorLVL/2+INT
